subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Coordinate proof of an orthocenter-circumcircle collinearity
units.statement: Put B=(0,0), C=(1,0), A=(u,v), D=(u,0), and H=(u,h). The condition AH=2HD gives v=3h and v squared=3u(1-u). The circumcircle and the circles with diameters BH and CH determine S and T; their slopes from D both equal (2u-1)/(4h), proving D,S,T collinear.
steps: Use the two altitude equations to locate H
Write the circumcircle and the two right-angle diameter circles
Subtract circle equations, find their nontrivial intersections, and compare slopes from D
